intent.proves: Every email (not a template) has an unsubscribe redirect page on itself or on its campaign folder.

bindings.reason: Handler not reserved: needs one call per subject (iterate ids from the list tool) and a client-side predicate. The campaign model does not expose the unsubscribe page.

bindings.query: SELECT CAST(e.EmailId AS nvarchar(20)) + N' ' + ISNULL(e.EmailName, N'') FROM EmailMarketingEmail e LEFT JOIN EmailMarketingTopFolder tf ON tf.TopFolderId = e.EmailTopFolderId WHERE ISNULL(e.EmailIsTemplate, 0) = 0 AND ISNULL(e.EmailUnsubscribePageId, 0) = 0 AND ISNULL(tf.TopFolderUnsubscribePageId, 0) = 0

sources.ref: nuget Dynamicweb.EmailMarketing 10.29.8 (table and column names in assembly SQL strings)
